title: SS27 Toddler Girls' Pearl and Tides
summary: Swim and beach for toddler girls in vintage pink, pastel green and soft navy, with UV protection.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Piccoli Principi's "Pearl & Tides" runs from vintage pink to pastel green and soft navy, with UV protection <sup>[1]</sup>; UV kidswear is becoming common <sup>[2]</sup>. Most SS27 kidswear sources describe collections across ages and genders. The evidence below is the fair record; the shapes, products and sizes are Forecut's application of it to toddler girls, roughly 1 to 4 years.

sections.heading: Colours
sections.body: Vintage pink, pastel green, soft navy.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- One-piece swimsuits with legs.
- Sun suits.
- Cover-up dresses.

design_implications:
- Easy dressing: snaps at the crotch, wide neck openings.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
